label: signed sweeping sanctions bill targeting Russia's energy sector and major purchasers of Russian oil and gas
detail: US President Donald Trump signed the Lindsey O Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026, which grants him broad powers to levy tariffs of up to 100% on the top five purchasers of Russian oil and gas, primarily China and India. The bill also imposes sanctions against Russian President Vladimir Putin, senior Russian government figures, banks, financial institutions, and Russia's shadow fleet of tankers.
source_title: Trump signs sweeping Russia sanctions bill

label: Congress approved a $1.9bn IMF loan
detail: Bolivia's Congress approved a $1.9bn International Monetary Fund loan, marking a major victory for President Rodrigo Paz. The loan requires austerity measures including continued fuel subsidy cuts and spending reductions, with the arrangement needing final approval from the IMF's Executive Board before funds are released.
source_title: Bolivia’s Congress approves $1.9bn IMF loan amid protest threats

label: dismissed UN nuclear watchdog resolution on nuclear weapons programme
detail: North Korea's Foreign Ministry dismissed an International Atomic Energy Agency resolution criticizing Pyongyang's nuclear weapons programme, stating its nuclear power status is irreversible and backed by its nuclear deterrent. Kim Yo Jong accused the IAEA of double standards for overlooking US and South Korea's nuclear activities while targeting North Korea's 'self-defensive and legitimate nuclear activities'.
source_title: North Korea dismisses UN nuclear watchdog resolution

label: imposed oil blockade causing widespread blackouts
detail: The USA has imposed an oil blockade on Cuba that began in January 2026, vastly worsening blackouts and leading to more frequent grid collapses. Cuba suffered a total nationwide blackout on September 19, 2026, the latest of at least six partial or total grid collapses since the beginning of the year, amid the ongoing US fuel blockade.
source_title: Cuba hit with another nationwide blackout amid US fuel blockade

label: conducted aerial strike on apartment building in Sumy killing at least two people
detail: Russian forces struck an apartment building in the eastern Ukrainian city of Sumy with a glide bomb on September 19, killing at least two people and injuring seven others, according to Ukrainian officials including President Volodymyr Zelensky.
source_title: Ukraine live: Russian strike on apartment building in Ukraine's Sumy kills at least two
